intro: Lesson 19. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ (٣١)

كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ (٣٢) وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ (٣٣) وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ (٣٤) إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ (٣٥) نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ (٣٦) لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ (٣٧)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
And [by] the night when it departs
And [by] the morning when it brightens,
Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Muddaththir 74:31-37 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 74:31-37 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 74:31-37 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, write what Allah swears by in 74:32 to 34.
questions.a: The moon, the night when it departs, and the morning when it brightens.

questions.q: Split 74:31 into its phrases at the waqf marks and memorise the first three.
questions.a: Phrases ending at each ۙ / ۚ mark; first three recited.

options: In phrases between its waqf marks, then link
questions.a: A) In phrases between its waqf marks, then link. 74:31 has several ۙ and ۚ marks: natural phrase breaks.

questions.q: Think again: 74:31 is one of the longest ayat in Juz' Tabarak. How would you memorise one very long ayah?
questions.a: Split it at its stopping marks into phrases, memorise each, then link them.
